articles.summary: RICHMOND, Va., July 15, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- The Brink’s Company (NYSE:BCO), a leading global provider of cash and valuables management, digital retail solutions, and ATM managed services, will host a conference call on Wednesday, August 5, at 9:00 a.m.
articles.title: Brink’s Schedules Second-Quarter 2026 Earnings Release and Conference Call for August 5, 2026

articles.summary: RICHMOND, Va., July 10, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- The Board of Directors of The Brink’s Company (NYSE:BCO) today declared a regular quarterly dividend of $0.255 per share on the Company’s common stock. The dividend is payable on September 1, 2026, to shareholders of record as of July 27, 2026.
articles.title: Brink’s Declares Quarterly Dividend
